meta_title: Elite Auto Keys Locksmith | Car & Home Locks Leicester
meta_description: Elite Auto Keys Locksmith in Leicester. Car unlocking, emergency lockouts, and key cutting. Available 24/7. Call now for same-day service.
hero_eyebrow: 24/7 Emergency Locksmith — Fast Response, Fair Pricing
hero_subhead: Locked out of your car or home in Leicester? We're here within the hour, any time of day or night.
services_subhead: From emergency lockouts to routine key cutting, we handle every lock problem fast and fairly.

services.title: Emergency Car Unlocking
services.desc: Locked out of your vehicle? We'll get you back inside without damage. Available 24/7, we aim for under 60 minutes response time anywhere in Leicester.

services.title: Home Lockout & Emergency Entry
services.desc: Keys lost, broken, or stuck inside? We open doors safely and can fit new locks same day if needed. All work fully guaranteed.

services.title: Key Cutting & Duplication
services.desc: Spare keys cut on the spot for cars, homes, and businesses. We carry stock of common blanks and can order specialist keys within 24 hours.

services.title: Lock Repairs & Replacement
services.desc: Broken or worn locks repaired or replaced swiftly. We fit high-security cylinders and modern mechanisms to keep your property safe.

services.title: Automotive Locksmith Services
services.desc: Locked boot? Lost car keys? We reprogram and cut new keys for most vehicles, even if you don't have the original.

services.title: Safe Opening & Servicing
services.desc: Locked safes, filing cabinets, or boxes opened without damage. We also service and repair safes to keep valuables secure.

about_pullquote: I started Elite because I was tired of customers being overcharged by distant call centres.
about_para_1: Elite Auto Keys was founded 18 years ago on a simple belief: locksmith support should be fast, honest, and local. We're a Leicester-based team with deep roots in the community. Every call is handled by someone who knows the city and your neighbourhood.
about_para_2: We've built our reputation on turning up quickly, solving the problem right first time, and keeping prices fair. Our customers come back because we treat emergencies like they matter—because they do. Whether it's midnight or midday, we're the Leicester locksmith you can trust.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Locked myself out of my car on a Sunday evening in the rain. Called Elite and they were with me in 40 minutes. Friendly lad, got it open without a scratch, charged a fair price. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Marcus T.

reviews.text: Emergency key cutting needed before Christmas and no other locksmiths answering calls. Elite came through. Quick, professional, and didn't try to rip me off like some do. Will definitely call again.
reviews.author: Jennifer H.

reviews.text: Came home to find my front door lock jammed. Phoned Elite, they sorted a new lock within 2 hours, fitted it properly, and the cost was reasonable. Top bloke, knows his stuff.
reviews.author: David P.
